Unique IDs for React key props

known_gotchas: Database locks occur with improper connection management
UNIQUE constraints on item_script_usage require conflict handling
Numeric names must be moved to item_id field, not kept as names
React keys must be unique to prevent rendering errors
Hue 0 (Default) needs special handling in database queries
performance_notes: Pagination used for script examples (10 per page)
Search is case-insensitive for better UX
